hypothesis: The lowest-resource path to useful WP507 causal-uptake evidence is to keep the acceptance path F2-native: first rebind/rebase PR226 to current main and validate its matched control/intervention contract; then add deterministic withheld-broadcast, shuffled-recipient and semantic-placebo refuters. If provenance inspectability is still weak, add only a tiny immutable OpenTelemetry-inspired witness-link projection using F2 deterministic identities. Do not import full OpenTelemetry, DoWhy, pyvene, baukit or TransformerLens into the WP507 acceptance path at this stage.

resource_rationale.otel: E2 recommends structural distillation only; full SDK adds processors/exporters/threading and droppable telemetry behavior.
resource_rationale.dowhy: E2 recommends F2-native deterministic placebo/refuter controls first; reserve statistical refutation/mediation for later offline analysis.
resource_rationale.pyvene: E2 rejects direct WP507 core use until an exact local model/J-Space ABI exists.
resource_rationale.baukit: Current E1 fusion prefers a tiny native PyTorch ActivationTap baseline and keeps baukit out of runtime dependency closure.
resource_rationale.pr226: Already contains the strongest current recipient-scoped matched-control contract implementation; replacing it would duplicate work and increase integration risk.

counterhypotheses: PR226 may encode insufficient witness completeness, so the tiny link projection could be necessary before reliable falsification.
Contract-level digest differences may reflect generic perturbation rather than semantic uptake; model-internal hooks may eventually be required after the local model/J-Space ABI exists.
PR226 non-mergeability may reflect substantive semantic conflicts rather than simple main drift; Trigger4 must inspect and revalidate rather than mechanically force-merge.
The native receipt model may already make every required relation explicit, making even an OpenTelemetry-inspired projection redundant.
next_discriminators: Trigger4: rebase or reconstruct PR226 against current main, then run exact-head repository CI before any acceptance promotion.
Trigger6: complete the already-claimed E3 F2-native placebo-refuter fixture; do not duplicate that claim.

After WP507 source exists on main: E4 ablation native receipts vs tiny witness-link projection measuring fail-closed completeness detection, deterministic replay equality, serialized bytes, CPU time and p50/p95 latency.
Defer pyvene/baukit/TransformerLens model-internal ablations until an exact local model/J-Space ABI and hook visibility are established.
authority_fence: Hypothesis handoff only. Trigger4 integration/measurement and exact accepted evidence outrank this synthesis.
